import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Record:
    source: str
    data: dict[str, Any]
    timestamp: float = 0.0

            "tags": self.tags,
            "metadata": self.metadata,

        merged_data = {**self.data, **other.data}

            timestamp=self.timestamp,
            record_id=self.record_id,
            tags=merged_tags,

    success: int = 0

        self.total += 1

        if self.total == 0:

        return self.success / self.total

    return combined
